// Package fixture is a TOY Idempotency-Key middleware over an in-memory store. It exists only so the
// harness selftest can compile and run templates/idempotency against something real: a correct
// middleware (green) and three deliberately broken ones (red), chosen by TOY_MUTATION:
//
//	store-retryable  a RETRYABLE answer is stored under the key instead of releasing it
//	drop-outcome     an OUTCOME answer is stored but the command's writes are rolled back
//	unclassified     one catalogue entry declares no replay class
package fixture

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"os"
)

// ProblemType is one entry of the toy catalogue.
type ProblemType struct {
	Slug   string
	Status int
	Class  string
}

// ProblemTypes is the toy's production catalogue.
func ProblemTypes() []ProblemType {
	out := []ProblemType{
		{"invalid-body", http.StatusBadRequest, "FINAL"},
		{"carrier-suspended", http.StatusConflict, "OUTCOME"},
		{"concurrent-modification", http.StatusConflict, "RETRYABLE"},
		{"dependency-unavailable", http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "RETRYABLE"},
	}
	if os.Getenv("TOY_MUTATION") == "unclassified" {
		out[1].Class = ""
	}
	return out
}

// Tx is the unit of work the middleware opens for a request.
type Tx struct{ tags []string }

// Add records one write in the transaction.
func (tx *Tx) Add(tag string) { tx.tags = append(tx.tags, tag) }

type txKey struct{}

// TxFrom returns the transaction the middleware bound into the request context.
func TxFrom(ctx context.Context) (*Tx, bool) {
	tx, ok := ctx.Value(txKey{}).(*Tx)
	return tx, ok
}

type row struct {
	body   string
	status int
	sum    string
	ctype  string
}

// Store is the toy key store plus the committed writes.
type Store struct {
	rows      map[string]row
	committed map[string]int
}

// NewStore returns a clean store.
func NewStore() *Store { return &Store{rows: map[string]row{}, committed: map[string]int{}} }

// Committed counts committed writes tagged tag.
func (s *Store) Committed(tag string) int { return s.committed[tag] }

// KeyRows counts the rows held for key.
func (s *Store) KeyRows(key string) int {
	if _, ok := s.rows[key]; ok {
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}

// capture buffers an answer so the middleware decides what to do with it, and carries the class mark.
type capture struct {
	hdr    http.Header
	status int
	body   bytes.Buffer
	class  string
}

func (c *capture) Header() http.Header { return c.hdr }
func (c *capture) WriteHeader(s int) {
	if c.status == 0 {
		c.status = s
	}
}
func (c *capture) Write(b []byte) (int, error) {
	c.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	return c.body.Write(b)
}

// MarkClass is what the production error writer calls on the capturing writer.
func (c *capture) MarkClass(class string) { c.class = class }

// Refuse is the toy's production error writer: it answers the problem type with this slug and marks
// the capturing writer with the class its catalogue entry declares.
func Refuse(w http.ResponseWriter, slug string) {
	for _, p := range ProblemTypes() {
		if p.Slug != slug {
			continue
		}
		if m, ok := w.(interface{ MarkClass(string) }); ok {
			m.MarkClass(p.Class)
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/problem+json")
		w.WriteHeader(p.Status)
		_, _ = io.WriteString(w, `{"slug":"`+p.Slug+`"}`)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusInternalServerError)
}

// RequireIdempotencyKey is the toy middleware.
func RequireIdempotencyKey(s *Store) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
	mutation := os.Getenv("TOY_MUTATION")
	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			key := r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key")
			raw, _ := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
			sum := string(raw)
			if key == "" {
				next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
				return
			}
			if prev, ok := s.rows[key]; ok {
				if prev.sum != sum {
					w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/problem+json")
					w.WriteHeader(http.StatusConflict)
					_, _ = io.WriteString(w, `{"slug":"idempotency-key-reused"}`)
					return
				}
				w.Header().Set("Content-Type", prev.ctype)
				w.Header().Set("Idempotency-Replayed", "true")
				w.WriteHeader(prev.status)
				_, _ = io.WriteString(w, prev.body)
				return
			}
			tx := &Tx{}
			c := &capture{hdr: http.Header{}}
			r = r.WithContext(context.WithValue(r.Context(), txKey{}, tx))
			next.ServeHTTP(c, r) // a panic leaves tx uncommitted and the key unstored
			if c.status == 0 {
				c.status = http.StatusOK
			}
			store, commit := false, false
			switch {
			case c.status >= http.StatusInternalServerError:
			case c.status < http.StatusMultipleChoices:
				store, commit = true, true
			case c.class == "RETRYABLE":
				store = mutation == "store-retryable"
			case c.class == "OUTCOME":
				store, commit = true, mutation != "drop-outcome"
			default:
				store = c.class == "FINAL"
			}
			if commit {
				for _, tag := range tx.tags {
					s.committed[tag]++
				}
			}
			if store {
				s.rows[key] = row{body: c.body.String(), status: c.status, sum: sum, ctype: c.hdr.Get("Content-Type")}
			}
			for k, v := range c.hdr {
				w.Header()[k] = v
			}
			w.WriteHeader(c.status)
			_, _ = w.Write(c.body.Bytes())
		})
	}
}
